children: SHANGHAI, Sept. 03, 2026
-- Fangzhou Inc. (“Fangzhou” or the “Company”)
HKEX:06086

, a leading provider of AI-driven Internet healthcare solutions, announced today that its “AI + Chronic Care” platform has been named to the 2026 Fortune China Best Designs list, recognizing the Company’s innovation and application of artificial intelligence in chronic disease management.
Fangzhou’s AI-Powered Chronic Care Model Named to Fortune China’s Best Designs 2026

Now in its fifth year, Fortune China’s Best Designs list evaluates projects across innovation, real-world implementation, industry value, and broader social impact. The 2026 list places a particular focus on artificial intelligence, recognizing projects that apply innovation to address industry challenges while demonstrating commercial potential and social value. Fangzhou’s inclusion highlights the practicality, scalability, and commercial viability of its AI-powered chronic care model.

Chronic disease management remains a critical pillar of China’s public healthcare system, yet traditional models face persistent challenges, including fragmented services, high labor costs, inconsistent patient follow-ups, and limited personalization. To address these structural constraints and long-term care needs, Fangzhou began exploring AI applications in healthcare as early as 2022.

In 2025, powered by its proprietary “XingShi” Large Language Model (XS LLM), the Company launched its “AI + Chronic Care” service model. By embedding AI functionality across the entire patient journey—including health monitoring, medication guidance, follow-up management, and health education—the platform connects fragmented services into a more seamless and personalized care experience.
As the Company scaled its deployment of XS LLM in 2026, the model delivered tangible benefits across both patient and physician workflows:
Workflow Optimization:
Streamlines service delivery across both physician and patient touchpoints by automating routine tasks and processes to enhance operational efficiency
Enhanced Care Quality & Patient Adherence:
Integrates professional clinical guidance into everyday health management, empowering individuals to build healthier routines and manage chronic conditions more effectively

This recognition from Fortune China marks another milestone in Fangzhou’s strategic evolution into a “full-lifecycle personal health service partner.” Looking ahead, the Company will continue to integrate AI technology across broader healthcare scenarios, advancing the scaled deployment of new capabilities to drive industry-wide efficiency and support the long-term development of digital healthcare.
